## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, 0 → 10 T) and n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T), T ≈ 1.2–1.3 K

Raw R(B) first, then R vs 1/B and the FFT in 1/B (poly-5 background in B), per the `sdh_onset` / `sdh_fft` helpers. Channel arithmetic as before: R = (sr1_X/1) / (sr0_X/−1e6), I_drain 9.9 nA; sr1 at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS) — both traces stay ≤ 0.12 FS, no rail; gate currents at their pA floors throughout (the ±100–200 pA excursions are the Keithley readback pattern, not leakage).

**Read (run 6, electron, F_L = 33.1 T for a single 4-fold FS):** oscillations from ~1.3 T, QH-like minima reaching ~0 Ω at 6.0 and 7.1 T, then a large envelope above 7.5 T (R → 530 Ω at 8.7 T, minimum at 9.8 T). The 3–10 T FFT is dominated by **~30 T** (≈ 0.9 F_L) with a second tone at **~7 T** (and 14 / 22 T at its harmonics or as combination tones); the deep minima sit at ν(cal) = 22.0 and 18.6 — not multiples of 4 with the current density scale. **Read (run 7, hole, F_L = 12.4 T):** oscillations from ~1 T, R → 0 near 1.7 and 3.4 T, maxima 2.4 / 4.0 T; FFT: **6.8 T** dominant plus **12.3 T (= F_L)** and weaker 3.5 / 4.6 / 8.5 T; the deep minima at 3.38 / 4.9 / 6.96 T are not evenly spaced in 1/B. **Take:** neither side is a single 4-fold SdH ladder — both carry ≥ 2 tones (two Fermi surfaces, or a split/8-fold degeneracy, or the region-B series alias at n + 0.43×10¹²). Alone, a single-density trace cannot separate those, and the non-integer ν/4 values say the absolute n scale (c_tg = geometry prior) is off at the ~10 % level. Both point at the same next step: a **Landau fan at D = 0** — the LL slopes dn/dB = νe/h fix the density scale, the filling sequence of the first gaps near the CNP gives the zero-energy degeneracy, and the per-column FFT gives the tone evolution with n. Plan step 4.

"""sdh-spot-check read, runs 6 (electron, n = +3.2e12) and 7 (hole, n = -1.2e12), D = 0:
raw R(B) first, then R vs 1/B, per-tone onsets (sdh_onset) and the FFT in 1/B (sdh_fft, poly-5 bg in B)."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset
from scipy.signal import find_peaks, savgol_filter

h_e = cst.h / cst.e                      # T m^2 per filling factor: nu = n h / (e B)
FS_R = 50e-6 / 10e-9                     # sr1 50 uV at 10 nA -> 5 kOhm full scale
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
for k, (rid, n12) in enumerate([(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    r = run(rid)
    print(summarize_run(r))
    chans = resolve_channels(r.meta); cur = current_channel(chans)
    v = [c for c in chans if not c.is_current][0]
    I = r.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    R = (r.col(v.col) / v.gain) / I
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R, I = B[o], R[o], I[o]
    F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16))
    print(f"run {rid}: I_drain {I.mean()*1e9:.2f} nA; R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm (max {R.max()/FS_R:.2f} of 5 kOhm FS); "
          f"F_L(|n| = {abs(n12)}e12, single 4-fold FS) = {F_L:.1f} T; nu(cal) at 10 T = {abs(n12)*1e16*h_e/10:.1f}")
    so = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=0.5, r_full_scale=FS_R)
    print(so.summary())
    m = B > 2.5; Rs = savgol_filter(R[m], 9, 2)
    mins, _ = find_peaks(-Rs, prominence=0.15 * (Rs.max() - Rs.min()))
    print("  deep minima B (T) / nu(cal):", [(round(float(B[m][i]), 2), round(float(abs(n12)*1e16*h_e/B[m][i]), 1)) for i in mins])
    ax = axes[k]
    ax[0].plot(B, R, lw=0.8); ax[0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)")
    ax[0].set_title(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 — raw Rxx(B)")
    ax[1].plot(1 / B[B > 0.8], R[B > 0.8], lw=0.8); ax[1].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)"); ax[1].set_title("raw vs 1/B")
    for lo, hi, c in [(1.5, 10.0, "k"), (3.0, 10.0, "C1")]:
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, hi), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
        sp = spec[0]; sel = (f > 1.0) & (f < 60)
        ax[2].plot(f[sel], sp[sel] / sp[sel].max(), c, lw=1, label=f"{lo}-{hi} T (dF = {1/(1/lo-1/hi):.1f} T)")
    ax[2].axvline(F_L, color="r", ls="--", label=f"F_L(n) = {F_L:.1f} T"); ax[2].axvline(F_L / 2, color="r", ls=":", label="F_L/2")
    ax[2].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm)"); ax[2].set_title("SdH FFT in 1/B (poly-5 bg in B)"); ax[2].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), B 1 → 10 T × n −1.25 … +3.30×10¹²

> **05:27** · landau-fan D=0: B slow 1.0-10.0 T x 0.1 T (91 rows), n fast -1.25..+3.30e12 (92 pts, dn 0.05) co-swept Vtg/Vbg on run-5 D=0 line, sr1 200 uV, fast\_delay 1.0; ends at 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~09:57** (≈4h30m)

**Why now (plan step 4; operator's request).** Runs 6–7 (ana) show ≥ 2 SdH tones on both carrier sides and deep minima whose filling factors are not multiples of 4 on the current density scale — a single-density trace cannot tell two Fermi surfaces (ABAB / ABCB) from a split single ladder (ABCA) or from the region-B series alias, and the absolute n scale still rests on the 9.5 nm c_tg prior. The fan answers all three at once: LL slopes dn/dB = νe/h calibrate n, the first-gap filling sequence at high B gives the zero-energy LL degeneracy (ν = ±8 then every 4 for a single ladder; crossings for two ladders; non-4 multiples / e-h asymmetry for ABCB), and a per-column FFT over B ≥ 3 T gives the tone evolution with n.

**Design.** Slow axis B = 1.0 → 10.0 T in 0.1 T (91 rows, uniform in B so LL lines are straight; the magnet sits at 0 T so the fan starts where it is and ends at 10 T for whatever rides down next). Fast axis: 92 co-swept (V_tg, V_bg) points on the calibrated D = 0 line (run-5 calibration: c_bg/c_tg = 0.773, c_tg = 2.796 mF/m², n_offset −0.089, D_offset −0.013), n = −1.25 → +3.30×10¹² in Δn = 0.05×10¹² (14 / 19 mV steps) — 10 pts per ν = 4 at 5 T, 20 at 10 T. **Coverage trade:** the hole side stops at −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit on the D = 0 line; the electron side at +3.30, 12 mV inside the TG limit) — the hole side is the only side we can't extend, so the ν-sequence read leans on the electron side; the field cap (10 T) is the card's. Sensitivity **200 µV = 20 kΩ FS** (0.6 Ω LSB, oscillation amplitudes ≥ 10 Ω above 1.5 T; runs 6–7 peaked at 590 Ω) — the ν = 0 core at high B may soft-clip above 20 kΩ; that loses the CNP peak value, not the gap positions, and is accepted rather than losing the low-R oscillations. Dwell: fast_delay 1.0 s at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB (operator-set) ≈ 3.3τ — a constant ~1–2-point lag in the +n direction on every row (slopes unaffected; the ν = 0 line is read from the fan itself). Leak guard trips at 1 nA on either Keithley; gates park at 0 in `finally`, field stays at 10 T.

**Price (calibrated).** Run 5: 1.17 s/pt incl. turnaround at fast_delay 1.0; runs 6–7: 3.1 s overhead per `magnet.field` set on top of the 0.137 T/min ramp. Row = 92 × 1.17 + 0.1 T/0.137 (44 s) + 3 s settle + ~6 s flyback/slow_delay ≈ 161 s → 91 rows ≈ 4 h 05 m + 7 min initial ramp; headline **≈ 4 h 30 m** (+5 % over the estimate, per session experience). **Checkpoints:** first rows at 1.0–1.2 T (rail? leakage? R(n) shows the CNP peak ~300 Ω and the run-7/6 end values ~150 / 50 Ω; abort if flat or clipped); ~3 T (row ~20, ~55 min: LL structure emerging on the electron side, fast-axis step adequate?); ~6 T (~2 h 15 m: partial fan re-formed, ν assignments); completion. Each checkpoint: continue / adjust / abandon with the price stated.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 1.0 -> 10.0 T (0.1 T, 91 rows) x n fast -1.25 -> +3.30e12 (92 pts, co-swept Vtg/Vbg) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, absolute scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.30, 92)                       # 1e12 cm^-2, dn = 0.05
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), **CAL)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.round(np.asarray(Vtg_vec), 5), np.round(np.asarray(Vbg_vec), 5)
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_vec.min() and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert BG_MIN <= Vbg_vec.min() and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.1), 3)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and len(B_vec) == 91
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, **CAL)
print(f"fast axis: {len(n_vec)} pts, n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 (dn {n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]:.3f}); "
      f"Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}] (step {abs(Vtg_vec[1]-Vtg_vec[0])*1e3:.1f} mV), "
      f"Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] (step {abs(Vbg_vec[1]-Vbg_vec[0])*1e3:.1f} mV); max |D| on line {np.abs(_D_chk).max():.4f} V/nm")
print(f"slow axis: {len(B_vec)} rows, B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, step {B_vec[1]-B_vec[0]:.2f} T; validators tg {k_tg.volt.vals}, bg {k_bg.volt.vals}, field {magnet.field.vals}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B| < 0.05: the fan ramps up from where the magnet sits), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA (0.6 Ohm LSB; nu = 0 core at high B may soft-clip -- accepted).
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (20 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB; "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan D = 0: B slow {B_vec[0]}-{B_vec[-1]} T step 0.1 ({len(B_vec)} rows), n fast {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts) "
                  f"co-swept Vtg/Vbg on the run-5 D = 0 line; sr1 200 uV; fast_delay 1.0, slow_delay 2.0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 (run-5 cal: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e} F/m2 prior, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm); '
              f'slow magnet.field {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T x 0.1 T ({len(B_vec)} rows); fast n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12, {len(n_vec)} pts (dn 0.05e12): '
              f'Vtg {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V; T_sample {_T0:.3f} K; Vsi 0')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(5)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, magnet.field, sr1.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B = {float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg = {float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg = {float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg| = {i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg| = {i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec], slow_delay=2.0, fast_delay=1.0)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
# field stays at 10 T (the next measurement rides it down) -- no field move here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
